title: Signal for rescue
summary: Three of anything is a distress signal: three fires, three whistle blasts, three flashes.

blocks.p: Three of anything is a distress signal: three fires in a triangle, three whistle blasts, three flashes. Repeat at intervals.
Ground-to-air symbols, as large as you can make them with high contrast: V means you need assistance, X means you need medical help.

blocks.cap: Use logs, rocks, clothing or trampled snow against a contrasting background, in an open area.

blocks.p: Use a mirror or your phone screen to flash sunlight at aircraft. Aim with two fingers in a V toward the target.

blocks.cap: Tilt the mirror until the spot of light falls on your fingers, then it’s hitting the aircraft too.
